subject: Semi-auto spread per shot and Match Trigger: M433, Mk 24, NSW4, B36A4
setup: Firing range, standing, ADS through a 4.50x optic. File names give weapon, ergonomic attachment (None or MatchTrigger) and fire mode; the attachment is not visible in the frame. 2560x1440, about 60 distinct frames per second in a 120 fps container.
sourceVideos: reference-data/Recordings/11192026/Semi Auto Spread/ (not in the repository; 17 files, 498 MB). The hashes below identify them. The operator planned to delete them after this receipt.

method.spreadIndicator: Every frame: pixels in rows 600-840, columns 1080-1480 with G>120, G-R>50, G-B>30; width = max x - min x, null when fewer than 12 pixels match.
method.viewKick: Every frame pair: OpenCV phaseCorrelate (Hanning window) on the grayscale band rows 20-330, columns 200-2100, which is the unmagnified ceiling outside the optic. A shot starts where frame motion exceeds 5 px after four frames under 2 px. Kick = largest displacement from the pre-shot position within 10 frames. Recovery = time from the peak until displacement falls to 50% and 20% of the kick, interpolated between frames.

limits: The four M433 slow clips differ in mean kick (60 to 68 px) with about 2 px scatter inside each clip; cause unknown.
NSW4 and B36A4 slow-fire results are one clip per condition.
Peak kick is sampled at about 60 frames per second.
stillsFolder: semi-auto-match-trigger-2026-11-19/ (one image per clip: rest and widest indicator frame, or the frames before shot 5 and at its peak kick)
